press_references.value: Embrace Enhances User-Focused Observability Platform with New Web RUM Product

product_launches.description: Embrace launched a new Web Real User Monitoring (RUM) product, expanding its observability platform from mobile to web and providing user-focused performance insights across all screens.

overview_description.description:
Embrace is the only user-focused observability platform that ties technical performance to end-user impact. Powered by OpenTelemetry, Embrace provides Real User Monitoring (RUM) across mobile and web, giving engineering teams the visibility and context they need to prioritize and resolve issues faster, optimize performance, and deliver exceptional digital experiences.

Embrace is a member of the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) and contributes to several OpenTelemetry Special Interest Groups (SIGs). Embrace counts AllTrails, Amazon, Cameo, GOAT, Hyatt, The New York Times, and many more as customers. Supported by NEA, AV8 (Allianz), Greycroft, and Eniac, Embrace is a YCombinator (YC Growth) company based in Los Angeles, Palo Alto, Buenos Aires, and London.

about_short_description.short_description: User-focused observability for mobile and web, built on OpenTelemetry

product.name: Embrace Platform
product.description: A cloud-based observability platform that connects mobile, web, and backend telemetry with user sessions, performance data, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and user journeys.

product.name: Mobile RUM
product.description: Real User Monitoring for mobile applications that captures user sessions and automatically collects crashes, ANRs, network issues, performance data, and custom events.

product.name: Web RUM
product.description: Real User Monitoring for web applications that analyzes Core Web Vitals, JavaScript errors, session timelines, user journeys, and performance impacts on business metrics.

product.name: Embrace AI
product.description: AI capabilities for querying and analyzing observability data, including automated workflows, natural-language discovery, and an MCP Server for AI-tool integration.

product.name: OpenTelemetry Integration
product.description: OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation and integration for collecting frontend telemetry and linking mobile and web user experiences with backend observability data.
